queries.question: What was NVIDIA's revenue, gross margin, operating income, diluted non-GAAP EPS, and GAAP EPS for Q3 FY2025 (period ending October 2024)?
queries.answer: Revenue $35.08B (YoY +93.6%), gross profit $26.16B, gross margin 74.6%, operating income $21.87B (operating margin 62.3%), net income $19.31B. Non-GAAP diluted EPS $0.81 (+19% QoQ, +103% YoY); GAAP diluted EPS $0.78.
queries.notes: Non-GAAP EPS in 8-K press release; GAAP EPS in financials page. Q3 FY2025 = period ending 2024-10-27.

queries.question: What was Meta Platforms' GAAP operating income, operating margin, net income, and diluted EPS for Q4 2024?
queries.answer: Operating income $23.36B, operating margin 48.3% (YoY +42.6%), net income $20.84B, net margin 43.1%, diluted GAAP EPS $8.02 (META does not publish a separate non-GAAP diluted EPS). Revenue $48.38B.
queries.notes: META's 8-K press release only reports GAAP EPS. Period ending 2024-12-31.

queries.question: What were Microsoft's diluted EPS, net income, and net margin for Q3 FY2025 (period ending March 2025)?
queries.answer: Diluted GAAP EPS $3.46, net income $25.82B, net margin 36.9% (YoY +17.7%). Revenue $70.07B, gross margin 68.7%. Microsoft does not separately report a non-GAAP diluted EPS in its press releases.
queries.notes: MSFT Q3 FY2025 = period ending 2025-03-31, filed 2025-04-30.

queries.question: What was Apple's revenue, gross profit, gross margin, and diluted EPS for Q1 FY2024 (holiday quarter ending December 2023)?
queries.answer: Revenue $119.58B (YoY +2.1%), gross profit $54.85B, gross margin 45.9%, operating income $40.37B, net income $33.92B, diluted GAAP EPS $2.18.
queries.notes: AAPL Q1 FY2024 = period ending 2023-12-30. Apple does not report a separate non-GAAP diluted EPS. Q1 is Apple's holiday quarter — largest by revenue in the fiscal year.

queries.question: What was NVIDIA's cash position, total assets, total debt, and stockholders equity at the end of Q4 FY2025 (January 2025)?
queries.answer: Cash & ST investments $43.21B, total assets $111.60B, total debt $10.27B, net debt $1.68B, stockholders equity $79.33B.
queries.notes: Period ending 2025-01-26. NVDA balance sheet is very lightly leveraged — net debt under $2B. Q4 FY2025 was the first quarter NVDA total assets exceeded $100B.

queries.question: What was Alphabet's cash and short-term investments, total debt, and stockholders equity at end of Q4 2024?
queries.answer: Cash & ST investments $95.66B, total debt $25.46B (long-term $22.57B, short-term $2.89B), stockholders equity $325.08B, total assets $450.26B.
queries.notes: Period ending 2024-12-31. GOOGL carries minimal debt relative to its cash position — net debt roughly neutral. Balance sheet is among the strongest in the big-tech peer group.

queries.question: What was Meta Platforms' cash and short-term investments, total assets, and stockholders equity at end of Q4 2024?
queries.answer: Cash & ST investments $77.81B, total assets $276.05B, stockholders equity $182.64B, total debt $49.06B, net debt $5.17B.
queries.notes: Period ending 2024-12-31. META's net debt is only $5.17B despite a $49B gross debt load — essentially running near net-cash-neutral.

queries.question: How much total debt did Apple carry versus stockholders equity at end of Q4 FY2024 (September 2024), and what was net debt?
queries.answer: Total debt $119.06B, stockholders equity $56.95B, total assets $364.98B, cash $65.17B, net debt $89.12B.
queries.notes: Period ending 2024-09-28. Apple carries ~2x more debt than equity by design — capital is returned via buybacks, not a sign of distress.

queries.question: What was NVIDIA's operating cash flow, capital expenditures, and free cash flow in Q3 FY2025?
queries.answer: Operating cash flow $17.63B, capex -$0.81B, free cash flow $16.81B (FCF margin ~47.9%).
queries.notes: Period ending 2024-10-27. NVDA's capex-light model: capex is under 5% of revenue, far below the typical hyperscaler. FCF margin of ~48% is exceptional for a semiconductor company.

queries.question: What were Microsoft's operating cash flow, capital expenditures, and free cash flow in Q4 FY2024 (June 2024)?
queries.answer: Operating cash flow $37.20B, capex -$13.87B, free cash flow $23.32B.
queries.notes: Period ending 2024-06-30. Capex was ~21% of revenue, reflecting ramp in Azure/AI data center investment. FCF declined from prior quarters as capex stepped up.

queries.question: What was Meta Platforms' operating cash flow, capex, and free cash flow in Q3 2024?
queries.answer: Operating cash flow $24.72B, capex -$8.26B, free cash flow $16.47B. Meta also repurchased $8.82B of stock in the same quarter.
queries.notes: Period ending 2024-09-30. Verified from _facts cash_flow. Numbers are correct.

queries.question: How much did NVIDIA spend on stock buybacks and what was stock-based compensation in Q3 FY2025?
queries.answer: Stock buybacks -$11.00B, stock-based compensation $1.25B, dividends paid -$0.24B.
queries.notes: Period ending 2024-10-27. Buybacks alone were ~31% of quarterly revenue — aggressive capital return relative to revenue.

queries.question: What was Apple's stock buyback spend and diluted shares outstanding in Q1 FY2024 (holiday quarter ending December 2023)?
queries.answer: Stock buybacks -$20.14B, diluted shares 15.58B, stock-based compensation $3.00B, dividends paid -$3.83B. Total capital returned to shareholders ~$24B in the quarter.
queries.notes: Period ending 2023-12-30. AAPL runs one of the largest shareholder return programs in history by dollar volume.

queries.question: What was Alphabet's capital expenditure and stock buyback spend in Q4 2024?
queries.answer: Capex -$14.28B, stock buybacks -$15.55B, stock-based compensation $5.81B, free cash flow $24.84B.
queries.notes: Period ending 2024-12-31. Combined data center capex and buybacks totaled ~$30B in the quarter. Numbers verified from raw _facts cash_flow data.

queries.question: What was NVIDIA's revenue breakdown by business segment in Q3 FY2025 — Data Center, Gaming, Automotive, and Professional Visualization?
queries.answer: Data Center $30.8B (+112% YoY, +17% QoQ), Gaming $3.3B (+15% YoY, +14% QoQ), Automotive $449M (+72% YoY, +30% QoQ), Professional Visualization $486M (+17% YoY, +7% QoQ). Data Center = ~88% of total revenue.
queries.notes: Segment data in the 8-K press release (EX-99.1), not in the FMP financials page. Total revenue $35.08B.

queries.question: What was Microsoft's revenue for each of its three reportable segments in Q3 FY2025, and what was Azure growth?
queries.answer: Intelligent Cloud $26.8B (+21% YoY), Productivity & Business Processes $29.9B (+10% YoY), More Personal Computing $13.4B (+6% YoY). Azure and other cloud services grew 33% YoY (35% in constant currency).
queries.notes: Segment revenue in the 8-K earnings press release. Period ending 2025-03-31.

queries.question: What was Alphabet's Google Services and Google Cloud revenue and operating income in Q4 2024?
queries.answer: Google Services revenue $84.1B (+10% YoY), Google Cloud revenue $12.0B (+30% YoY). Operating income: Google Services $32.836B, Google Cloud $2.093B (Google Cloud operating income doubled YoY from $864M).
queries.notes: Segment data from 8-K press release. Total GOOGL revenue Q4 2024 was $96.47B.

queries.question: What was NVIDIA's year-over-year revenue and operating income growth from Q3 FY2024 (October 2023) to Q3 FY2025 (October 2024)?
queries.answer: Revenue: $18.12B (Q3 FY2024) to $35.08B (Q3 FY2025) = +93.6% YoY. Operating income: $10.42B to $21.87B = +109.9% YoY. Net income: $9.24B to $19.31B = +108.9% YoY.
queries.notes: Requires both Q3 FY2024 and Q3 FY2025 financials pages. YoY growth driven by Data Center AI compute demand.

queries.question: How did Meta Platforms' operating margin and revenue change quarter-over-quarter from Q3 2024 to Q4 2024?
queries.answer: Revenue: $40.59B (Q3 2024) to $48.38B (Q4 2024) = +19.2% QoQ. Operating margin: 42.7% (Q3) to 48.3% (Q4) = +5.6pp QoQ. Net income: $15.69B to $20.84B = +32.8% QoQ.
queries.notes: Requires both Q3 and Q4 2024 pages. Q4 seasonality + ad pricing drives the step-up.

queries.question: How did Microsoft's gross margin and operating margin change quarter-over-quarter from Q4 FY2024 (June 2024) to Q3 FY2025 (March 2025)?
queries.answer: Gross margin: 69.6% (Q4 FY2024) to 68.7% (Q3 FY2025) = -0.9pp. Operating margin: 43.1% to 45.7% = +2.6pp. Revenue grew from $64.73B to $70.07B over the same span.
queries.notes: Q4 FY2024 = period ending 2024-06-30; Q3 FY2025 = period ending 2025-03-31. This comparison spans three calendar quarters, not consecutive quarters — the QoQ label is technically three periods apart.

queries.question: What next-quarter revenue guidance has NVIDIA given across recent earnings calls?
queries.answer: FY2024 Q3 call (Nov 2023): Q4 FY2024 guided to $20.0B ±2%. FY2025 Q1 call (May 2024): Q2 FY2025 guided to $28.0B ±2%.
queries.notes: Guidance numbers appear only in transcript, not in financials pages.

queries.question: What has Jensen Huang said across earnings calls about the revenue opportunity for cloud providers running NVIDIA infrastructure?
queries.answer: On the FY2025 Q1 call (May 2024): Jensen Huang described a cloud revenue multiplier — for every $1 in NVIDIA AI infrastructure spend, a cloud provider can earn approximately $5 in GPU hosting revenue over four years. Same call: token generation would drive a multi-year build-out of AI factories.
queries.notes: The $1→$5 cloud revenue multiple is a key Jensen analogy unique to transcript. Verbatim source: 'For every $1 spent on NVIDIA AI infrastructure, cloud providers have an opportunity to earn $5 in GPU instant hosting revenue over four years.' Also: 'Token generation will drive a multiyear build-out of AI factories.'

queries.question: How has NVIDIA described its China and export-control situation across earnings calls — revenue exposure, expected declines, and the H20 ban impact?
queries.answer: FY2024 Q3 call: China and licensed destinations were consistently approximately 20–25% of Data Center revenue; sales expected to decline significantly in Q4 FY2024. FY2025 Q2 call: China DC revenue grew sequentially in Q2 but was still below the levels seen before export controls were imposed. FY2026 Q1 call (May 2025): H20 ban effective April 9 — $4.6B H20 revenue recognized pre-ban, $4.5B inventory write-down and purchase obligation charge, $2.5B unable to ship. China AI accelerator market estimated to grow to nearly $50 billion.
queries.notes: Spans three calls. The 20–25% figure and the H20 $4.5B charge are both transcript-only disclosures. Verbatim from FY2025 Q2: 'remains below levels seen prior to the imposition of export controls.'

queries.question: How has Meta's annual capex guidance changed across earnings calls as AI infrastructure demand grew?
queries.answer: Q1 2024 call: full-year 2024 capex guided to $35B–$40B, raised from the prior range of $30B–$37B, citing accelerating infrastructure investment. Q2 2024 call: raised again to $37B–$40B (from $35B–$40B), driven by Llama 4 requiring roughly 10x more compute than Llama 3. Q4 2024 call: 2025 full-year capex $60B–$65B, with close to 1 gigawatt of capacity coming online in 2025.
queries.notes: Three successive raises: $30–37B → $35–40B → $37–40B → $60–65B for following year. Verbatim from Q2 2024: 'almost 10 times more compute'; from Q4 2024: 'almost 1 gigawatt of capacity.'

queries.question: What has Alphabet signaled about its capital expenditure trajectory across earnings calls, and what specific 2025 commitment did it announce?
queries.answer: Q4 2023 call (Jan 2024): Q4 2023 capex was $11B; full-year 2023 was ~$32B; for 2024, capex expected to be notably larger than in 2023. Q4 2024 call (Feb 2025): 2025 full-year capex ~$75B, with approximately $16B–$18B expected in Q1 2025 alone; broke ground on 11 new cloud regions and data center campuses in 2024; announced 7 new subsea cable projects.
queries.notes: 2023 full-year capex ~$32B verified from quarterly financials. 2025 commitment of $75B is a transcript-only disclosure. Verbatim from Q4 2023: 'we expect investment in CapEx will be notably larger than in 2023.'

queries.question: What has NVIDIA disclosed across earnings calls about Blackwell production challenges, ramp timeline, and the scale at which hyperscalers are deploying Blackwell?
queries.answer: FY2025 Q2 call (Aug 2024): NVIDIA changed the Blackwell GPU mask to improve production yields. Blackwell production ramp was scheduled to begin in Q4 and continue into FY2026. Demand for Blackwell was well above supply, expected to persist into the following year. FY2026 Q1 call (May 2025): Blackwell contributed ~70% of data center compute revenue; Microsoft had already deployed Blackwell GPUs in the tens-of-thousands range, ramping toward hundreds of thousands of GB200s; major hyperscalers each deploying close to 72,000 Blackwell GPUs per week.
queries.notes: Mask change for yield is a supply chain disclosure unique to the FY2025 Q2 transcript. Verbatim from FY2025 Q2: 'We executed a change to the Blackwell GPU mask to improve production yields. Blackwell production ramp is scheduled to begin in the fourth quarter and continue into fiscal year 26. Demand for Blackwell platforms is well above supply, and we expect this to continue into next year.'

queries.question: What specific named customers and their GPU cluster sizes has Jensen Huang cited across NVIDIA earnings calls?
queries.answer: FY2024 Q3 call: Tesla upgraded to 7,000 A100 GPUs for autopilot training; UK Isambard-AI built with ~5,500 Grace Hopper Superchips; Germany Jülich centre building with ~24,000 Grace Hopper Superchips. FY2025 Q1 call: Tesla expanded training cluster to 35,000 H100 GPUs; Meta trained Llama 3 on a cluster of 24,000 H100 GPUs. FY2026 Q1 call: Microsoft deployed Blackwell GPUs at the tens-of-thousands scale, expected to reach hundreds of thousands of GB200s, with OpenAI as a key customer.
queries.notes: Cluster sizes grow across calls: 7K A100s → 35K H100s → tens/hundreds of thousands Blackwell. Verbatim from FY2026 Q1: 'Microsoft, for example, has already deployed tens of thousands of Blackwell GPUs and is expected to ramp to hundreds of thousands of GB200s with OpenAI as one of its key customers.'

queries.question: What has Meta said across earnings calls about its MTIA custom AI chip — what workloads it runs, the rollout timeline, and why Meta is building its own silicon?
queries.answer: Q4 2024 call: Starting in 2024, Meta began deploying its MTIA custom chip for ranking and recommendation inference in ads and organic content. Plans to expand MTIA adoption across those use cases in 2025 before extending to training workloads for ranking and recommendations. Rationale: achieving lower cost of compute by optimizing the chip to Meta's unique workloads, since off-the-shelf silicon is not necessarily optimal.
queries.notes: MTIA details first disclosed substantively on the Q4 2024 call. Verbatim source: 'In 2024 we started deploying MTIA to our ranking and recommendation inference workloads for ads and organic content. We expect to further ramp adoption of MTIA for these use cases throughout 2025 before extending our custom silicon efforts to training workloads for ranking and recommendations next year.' Also: 'pursuing cost efficiencies by deploying our custom MTIA silicon in areas where we can achieve a lower cost of compute by optimizing the chip to our unique workloads… off-the-shelf silicon isn't necessarily optimal.'

queries.question: What custom silicon chips has Microsoft named across earnings calls, and what data center capacity milestones has it cited?
queries.answer: FY2024 Q3 call (Apr 2024): Microsoft described its accelerator lineup as the broadest in the industry — NVIDIA, AMD, and its own first-party silicon. FY2025 Q2 call (Jan 2025): first-party chip names disclosed — Maia, Cobalt, Boost, and HSM. Capacity milestone: data center capacity had more than doubled over the prior three years, with more added in the most recent year than in any prior year.
queries.notes: Maia and Cobalt are the headline names; Boost and HSM are less widely reported but appear in the FY2025 Q2 transcript. Verbatim from Q3 FY2024: 'We offer the most diverse selection of AI accelerators, including the latest from NVIDIA, AMD, as well as our own first-party silicon.' Verbatim from Q2 FY2025: 'We have more than doubled our overall data center capacity in the last three years and we have added more capacity last year than any other year in our history.'

queries.question: How has Google described its TPU technology and named AI customers on Google Cloud across earnings calls?
queries.answer: Q4 2023 call: AI Hypercomputer with TPUs and GPUs; named customers Anthropic, Character AI, Essential AI, and Mistral AI; Vertex AI API requests up ~6x from H1 to H2 2023. Q4 2024 call: Trillium (6th-gen TPU) offers a 4x training speedup and 3x inference throughput improvement over the prior generation; Google Cloud was first to run a customer on the Blackwell platform.
queries.notes: Anthropic, Character AI, Mistral as named TPU customers is a key supplier/customer detail unique to transcript. Verbatim from Q4 2024: 'delivers 4x better training performance and 3x greater inference throughput' vs prior generation.

queries.question: What has Apple disclosed across earnings calls about its active device count, paid subscriptions, and major product launches?
queries.answer: Q4 FY2024 call (Nov 2023): iPhone revenue $43.8B (September quarter record); Services $22.3B (+16% YoY), all-time record; paid subscriptions exceeded 1 billion — close to double the count from three years prior; all-time records in India, plus September quarter records in Brazil, Canada, France, Indonesia, and others. Q1 FY2024 call (Feb 2024): 2.2B active devices; paid subscriptions exceeded 1 billion — more than double the count from four years prior; Apple Vision Pro launched the following day (February 2, 2024).
queries.notes: 2.2B active devices and 1B paid subscriptions are transcript-only milestone disclosures. Verbatim from Q4 FY2024: 'nearly double the number we had only three years ago.' Verbatim from Q1 FY2024: 'more than double the number that we had only four years ago.'

queries.question: What GPU throughput or performance numbers has NVIDIA cited across earnings calls to illustrate generational improvement?
queries.answer: FY2024 Q3 call: H100 HGX system has 35,000 parts, weighs 70 pounds, contains 8 Hopper chips; InfiniBand networking grew fivefold year-on-year. FY2025 Q1 call: a single HGX H200 server delivers 24,000 tokens per second, supporting over 2,400 concurrent users running Llama 3 at 70B parameters.
queries.notes: 35K parts / 70 lbs for H100 and 24K tokens/sec for H200 are vivid spec disclosures unique to transcripts. Verbatim from FY2025 Q1: 'a single NVIDIA HGX H200 server can deliver 24,000 tokens per second, supporting more than 2,400 users at the same time' running Llama 3.

queries.question: On Microsoft's Q3 FY2024 earnings call, what did the company disclose about GitHub Copilot subscriber count and Fortune 500 enterprise adoption?
queries.answer: GitHub Copilot reached 1.8M paid subscribers as of Q3 FY2024, with growth running above 35% quarter-over-quarter. Nearly 60% of Fortune 500 companies were using Copilot. The call also announced multiple large multi-year AI deals including agreements with Cloud Software Group and Coca-Cola exceeding $1B combined.
queries.notes: Subscriber count and Fortune 500 adoption are transcript-only KPIs. Verbatim source: 'growth accelerating to over 35% quarter-over-quarter'; 'nearly 60% of the Fortune 500 now use Copilot.' Previous question scope said 'across earnings calls' (plural) but gold set is single transcript — narrowed to Q3 FY2024 specifically.

queries.question: What has Meta disclosed across earnings calls about AI-driven content recommendations and the impact of AI on its advertising systems?
queries.answer: Q1 2024 call: for the first time, more than half of Instagram content was AI-recommended; ~30% of Facebook Feed posts delivered by AI recommendation, up 2x over two years. Q4 2024 call: Meta AI reached 700M monthly actives; Advantage+ shopping surpassed $20B annual run-rate, growing 70% YoY in Q4; Andromeda (built with NVIDIA) enabled a 10,000x increase in the complexity of models used for ads retrieval.
queries.notes: The Instagram 50% AI-recommended stat and the Andromeda 10,000x model complexity claim are transcript-only disclosures. The Instagram stat appears on the Q1 2024 call, not Q2. Verbatim from Q4 2024: '10,000 times increase in the complexity of models we use for ads retrieval.'

queries.question: What have companies disclosed across earnings calls about the compute scale required to train their next-generation AI models?
queries.answer: Meta Q2 2024: Llama 4 training expected to require roughly 10x the compute used for Llama 3. Meta Q4 2024: Llama 4 mini completed pre-training; planning close to 1 gigawatt of capacity for 2025 and a 2GW+ datacenter. NVDA FY2025 Q1: Meta trained Llama 3 on 24,000 H100 GPUs; Tesla runs 35,000 H100s for training.
queries.notes: Cross-company question — multiple transcripts required for a complete answer. Verbatim from META-2024-Q2: 'almost 10 times more compute'; from META-2024-Q4: 'almost 1 gigawatt of capacity.'

queries.question: What has Alphabet disclosed across earnings calls about its data center buildout, subsea cables, and cloud infrastructure investment scale?
queries.answer: Alphabet has sharply increased infrastructure spend: 2023 capex ~$32B with Q4 at $11B; 2025 capex guided to ~$75B with Q1 2025 alone ~$16–18B. In 2024 Alphabet started construction on 11 new cloud regions and data center campuses, and announced 7 new subsea cable projects. Google states its newest data centers deliver roughly 4x more compute per unit of electricity than five years prior.
queries.notes: 7 subsea cables and 11 cloud region groundbreakings are Q4 2024 transcript-only disclosures. Verbatim from Q4 2024: 'in 2024, we broke ground on 11 new cloud regions and data center campuses'; 'Google data centers deliver nearly 4x more computing power per unit of electricity compared to just 5 years ago.' Verbatim from Q4 2023: 'we expect investment in CapEx will be notably larger than in 2023.'

queries.question: What has Meta said across earnings calls about the physical scale of its AI infrastructure buildout?
queries.answer: Q2 2024 call: Meta was planning for the compute scale and data infrastructure needed over the next several years. Q4 2024 call: expecting to bring nearly 1 gigawatt of new capacity online in 2025; building a datacenter exceeding 2 gigawatts — large enough to span a significant portion of Manhattan. 2025 capex $60B–$65B.
queries.notes: The Manhattan-scale datacenter analogy is a Zuckerberg quote unique to the Q4 2024 call. Verbatim from Q2 2024: 'We are planning for the compute clusters and data we'll need for the next several years.' Verbatim from Q4 2024: 'we expect to bring online almost 1 gigawatt of capacity this year, and we're building a 2 gigawatt and potentially bigger AI datacenter, that is so big that it will cover a significant part of Manhattan if it were placed there.'

queries.question: What has Google management said across earnings calls about the pace of AI workload adoption on Google Cloud — developer counts, compute consumption, and enterprise customers?
queries.answer: Q4 2023 call: Vertex AI API requests up ~6x from H1 to H2 2023; AI Hypercomputer customers include Anthropic, Character AI, Mistral AI, Essential AI. Q4 2024 call: more than 4.4M developers using Gemini models — double the count from six months prior; Cloud customers consuming more than 8x the compute capacity for training and inferencing compared to 18 months earlier.
queries.notes: 8x compute consumption and 4.4M Gemini developers are transcript-only adoption signals. Verbatim from Q4 2024: 'double the number from just 6 months ago'; 'cloud customers consume more than 8x the compute capacity for training and inferencing compared to 18 months ago.'

queries.question: What has Microsoft management said across earnings calls about Azure AI capacity, demand versus supply dynamics, and AI's contribution to Azure growth?
queries.answer: FY2024 Q3 call (Apr 2024): Azure AI contributed 7 points of growth to Azure overall; commercial bookings up 29%; first-party silicon offered alongside NVIDIA and AMD. FY2025 Q2 call (Jan 2025): data center capacity had more than doubled over the prior three years, with more added in the most recent year than in any prior year; Azure described as the infrastructure layer for AI.
queries.notes: The 7-point AI contribution to Azure growth is a CFO disclosure unique to transcript. Verbatim from Q2 FY2025: 'We have more than doubled our overall data center capacity in the last three years and we have added more capacity last year than any other year in our history.'

queries.question: What have the major hyperscalers committed to spending on AI infrastructure, and how have those commitments scaled over successive earnings calls?
queries.answer: Meta: 2024 capex raised to $37B–$40B (Q2 2024 call); 2025 guided to $60B–$65B (Q4 2024 call). Alphabet: full-year 2023 capex ~$32B; 2024 capex expected to be notably larger (Q4 2023 call); 2025 commitment ~$75B (Q4 2024 call). NVDA (FY2026 Q1 call): hyperscalers each deploying an average of roughly 72,000 Blackwell GPUs per week.
queries.notes: Cross-company aggregation question. Alphabet 2023 full-year capex ~$32B verified from quarterly financials data. Verbatim from Q4 2023 GOOGL: 'we expect investment in CapEx will be notably larger than in 2023.'

queries.question: What were NVIDIA's full-year FY2025 revenue and Data Center revenue, and what Q1 FY2026 guidance did the company give in its earnings press release?
queries.answer: FY2025 total revenue $130.5B (+114% YoY), Data Center $115.2B (+142% YoY), GAAP EPS $2.94 (+147%). Q1 FY2026 guidance: revenue $43.0B ±2%, GAAP gross margin 70.6% ±50bps.
queries.notes: Q1 FY2026 guidance and FY2025 full-year totals only in the 8-K press release.

queries.question: Which cloud providers were named in NVIDIA's earnings press release as deploying GB200 NVL72 systems?
queries.answer: AWS, CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and Oracle Cloud were all named as cloud providers bringing GB200 systems to market. Also named: SoftBank (Japan), Foxconn (Taiwan), Denmark sovereign AI — 1,528 H100 GPUs.
queries.notes: Named cloud and sovereign AI partners are 8-K-only disclosures, not in earnings transcripts.

queries.question: What did NVIDIA's earnings press release say about the xAI Colossus cluster and sovereign AI supercomputer deployments?
queries.answer: xAI Colossus: deployed 100,000 Hopper GPUs with Spectrum-X Ethernet. Sovereign AI deployments: Denmark's largest sovereign AI deployment (1,528 H100 GPUs, Quantum-2 InfiniBand fabric); SoftBank building Japan's top-ranked AI supercomputer on Blackwell; Foxconn building Taiwan's leading AI supercomputer on Blackwell.
queries.notes: Source verbatim for Denmark: 'Launched Denmark s largest sovereign AI supercomputer, an NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD driven by 1,528 NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPUs and interconnected using NVIDIA Quantum-2 InfiniBand networking.' Source verbatim for Japan: 'SoftBank Corp. is building Japan s most powerful AI supercomputer with the NVIDIA Blackwell platform.' Source verbatim for Taiwan: 'Unveiled a partnership with Foxconn to build Taiwan s fastest AI supercomputer with NVIDIA Blackwell.'

queries.question: What were the growth rates for Microsoft's sub-segments — LinkedIn, Dynamics 365, and Search & news ads — in its Q3 FY2025 earnings press release?
queries.answer: LinkedIn +7% (up 8% constant currency), Dynamics 365 +16% (up 18% CC), Search & news ads excluding TAC +21% (up 23% CC). Microsoft Cloud overall $42.4B (+20%). Azure +33% (up 35% CC). $9.7B returned to shareholders via dividends and buybacks.
queries.notes: Sub-segment growth rates at this granularity appear only in the 8-K press release.

queries.question: What were Meta's full-year 2024 revenue, operating income, free cash flow, and capex from its earnings press release, and what Q1 2025 guidance did it provide?
queries.answer: FY2024: revenue $164.5B (+22%), operating income $69.4B (+48%), operating margin 42% (up 7pp), diluted EPS $23.86 (+60%), free cash flow $52.1B, capex $39.23B. Q1 2025 guidance: revenue $39.5B–$41.8B (8–15% growth). FY2025 capex: $60B–$65B.
queries.notes: Full-year FCF and capex totals are 8-K-only; transcript gives quarterly run-rate.

queries.question: What does Alphabet's FY2024 10-K say is the primary risk from its revenue concentration in digital advertising?

queries.question: What packaging technology does NVIDIA use for its AI chips, and what supply risk does this create?
queries.answer: NVIDIA uses CoWoS (Chip on Wafer on Substrate) packaging for its AI chips. CoWoS capacity sits primarily with TSMC and requires specialized equipment and know-how, creating single-source exposure. Two CoWoS variants exist for Blackwell: CoWoS-L and CoWoS-S. The FY2025 10-K names poor manufacturing yields as a supply risk. Dylan Patel's August 2024 analysis detailed the Blackwell packaging variants.

queries.question: How has Meta's most prominently stated risk in its annual 10-K filings evolved from FY2021 through FY2025?
queries.answer:
Consistent #1 risk across all five annual filings: user retention and engagement — losing existing users or failing to grow the user base is cited as an existential risk in every year.

FY2021 (10-k-2022-02-03): COVID-19 listed as operational risk; Apple iOS/ATT changes cited from 2021; EU Digital Markets Act described as proposed legislation; no standalone Reality Labs loss risk.

FY2022 (10-k-2023-02-02): DMA now enacted with concrete requirements; COVID risk fading; 11,000-employee restructuring disclosed; generative AI first mentioned as a product development tool.

FY2023 (10-k-2024-02-02): Reality Labs operating losses added as an explicit standalone risk; RL losses projected to grow materially in 2024; EU GDPR and DMA enforcement broadening; AI governance risks added.

FY2024 (10-k-2025-01-30): Under-16 social media legislation cited; EU DMA formal proceedings opened March 2024; RL losses projected to increase further in 2025; US regulatory environment described as worsening.

FY2025 (10-k-2026-01-29): Broadest regulatory disclosure ever — GDPR, DMA, DSA, UK Online Safety Act, and EU AI Act all named; RL losses expected to hold roughly flat year-over-year (first year not projected to grow); TikTok ban precedent cited as evidence of US government willingness to regulate social platforms.
queries.notes: Qualitative time series — answer tracks language evolution across 5 annual 10-Ks, not numbers. Tests cross-temporal document retrieval. Source quotes: #1 risk in all 5 years — 'If we fail to retain existing users or add new users, or if our users decrease their level of engagement with our products'; FY2023 10-K — 'we expect our RL operating losses to increase meaningfully in 2024'; FY2025 10-K — 'we expect our 2026 RL operating losses to remain similar to 2025'.
